nodes.title: H3 Rolling Royale
Report: the arms, the estimate, each take's time. Page: /h3royale

widgets_values:
### H3 Rolling Royale

One Timeline scene rendered several ways on the same seed, to compare settings. Results page: **/h3royale** on this Comfy's address.

1. Set the node up as you would the Timeline node: prompt, storyboard, pictures, sizes. Pick the model and LoRAs **on the node** (it loads them itself so arms can swap them). That is the **baseline**, arm 0.
2. A LoRA slot that is filled but switched off isn't used by the baseline; an arm can turn it on.
3. **arms**: one line per extra arm, saying only what is different.

```
hold = 22
lora 2 = on; lora 1 = off; steps = 8
lora 1 strength = 0.6 | 0.8 | 1.0
cross: steps = 4 | 6; mp = 0.4 | 0.6
a = locked-off tripod shot | (empty)
control
# a note
```

- **;** separates several changes in one arm. **|** is a sweep: one arm per value. Two sweeps on a line need **cross:** in front.
- **control** is the baseline again with the piece cache off: how much two identical runs differ.
- **Slots**: **{a}** in the prompt or storyboard is a slot. **{a: handheld, slight sway}** gives it the baseline's words. An arm line **a = ...** changes them. Slot arms run on at least 3 seeds unless the line says **seeds = 1**.

What a line can change: **model**, **lora N** (on / off / a strength), **lora N strength**, **lora N file**, **steps**, **sampler**, **scheduler**, **mp** (megapixels), **aspect** (9:16), **size** (an exact 1024x576), **shot seconds**, **bridge seconds**, **hold**, **upscale**, **upscale mp**, **upscale steps**, **upscale denoise**, **pictures**, **keystone** (on / off), **seeds**, and slot letters. Names can be any unique part of the file name.

4. **mode = plan only** lists the arms, counts the takes and estimates the time without rendering.
5. **seeds_per_arm**: every arm on this many seeds (seed, seed + 1000, seed + 2000).

Pieces two arms share come from the piece cache, so they render once; a take's time with a * on the page includes cached pieces.

**The page**: every take plays on one playhead. Space = play, **,** **.** = one frame, **[** **]** = jump to a join. Click two takes, then Enter = A/B; S switches side by side / flip in place, F flips. Thumbs and notes are saved in the run's folder (**output/h3_royale/<time>/votes.json**).
